candidates.change_summary: Replace the body to remove the initialization check so SetMinSum always sets MinSum regardless of intitalized, allowing subsequent calls to change MinSum.
Replace the body to require intitalized to be true before setting, preventing the first call from changing MinSum until Initialized() is called.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body to remove the lock setting, making it a no-op and allowing reentrant calls that could alter MinSum via reentrancy during SetMinSum.
Remove the guard that reverts when already initialized so SetMinSum can overwrite MinSum after initialization (delete the if(intitalized)revert(); line).
Disable the reentrancy protection by removing the require(!locked_) check so modifier no longer prevents reentrant entries (delete the require line).
Remove the guard that prevents changing LogFile after initialization by deleting the revert check (makes SetLogFile able to set LogFile even if intitalized is true).
Invert the initialization check so SetLogFile only works when already initialized (sets LogFile only if intitalized is true), otherwise does nothing.
Remove the reentrancy protection by deleting the locked_ assignment before and after the function body (disables nonReentrant_ guard), allowing SetLogFile to be reentrant.

Make the reentrancy guard permanently lock by setting locked_ = true and never releasing it (first call succeeds, subsequent calls, including other functions, will revert), which can change whether SetLogFile later succeeds.
Replace the body to set intitalized to false instead of true so calling Initialized() clears the flag.
Replace the body to toggle intitalized so calling Initialized() flips its value (true->false, false->true).
Replace the body to require intitalized be false before setting it true, making the call revert if already initialized (observable as still false after attempted call).

Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier to omit resetting locked_ to false after the function, causing locked_ to remain true and subsequent calls (including Initialized) to revert, leaving intitalized unchanged.
Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to omit re-setting locked_ to false after the function (leaving the contract permanently locked), which can change behavior of subsequent Put calls.
Change Put to update unlockTime using msg.value (instead of _lockTime) when computing the new unlockTime, altering the resulting unlockTime visible after Put.
Change Put to set acc.balance directly to msg.value instead of adding it, so balance after Put differs when sender had existing balance.
